key_insight: A smooth activation inspired by the regularized Biot–Savart kernel improves incompressible-flow PINN accuracy without changing the velocity–pressure formulation.
engineering_relevance: Physics-informed activation design offers a targeted way to improve neural fluid simulations, including resolution of localized shear structures.
method: Extract a rational activation profile from a regularized Biot–Savart kernel.
Test fixed-scale and learnable-scale activation variants.
Retain conventional velocity–pressure outputs and physics-informed training.
evidence_signal: Across 21 benchmark–architecture comparisons spanning five flow benchmarks, the fixed- and learnable-scale variants reduced combined velocity error versus tanh PINNs by mean values of 31.7% and 33.2%, respectively.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish computational-cost savings or generalization beyond the five tested flow benchmarks.
paper_title: Stochastic Representation-Inspired Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Incompressible Fluid Flows
